messages:
incident-bot: Pager — SEV1: StratusMall (private VPC) auth failures across dedicated pool (pager duty: oncall-jess). Impact: customers unable to connect to dedicated inference endpoints; 100% auth rejects. Auto-runbook: tag=auth OIDC-introspection-failures

oncall-jess: I'm on it. Paging infra-ops-miguel & eng-identity. Can someone confirm whether this started after the scheduled key rotation?

customer-stratus-eng: We saw errors at ~02:12 UTC, immediately after we rotated keys on our IdP. Some clients show 401 with body: "invalid_token". No other changes on our side.

infra-ops-miguel: checking dedicated pool logs now. Seeing repeated TLS handshake failures from worker-3 to customer identity proxy: "tls: handshake failure" and later a bunch of JWT validation errors: "kid not found".

platform-sre: quick telemetry: authentication reject rate jumped from 0.2% -> 82% between 02:11-02:14 UTC for tenant stratusmall. Route map shows traffic hitting dedicated-pool-east-1 cluster.

eng-identity: can you paste a sample failing Authorization header (redact token)? I want header.kid value vs our JWKS cache.

support-ryan: pasted minimal request from customer (redacted):
```
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6InN0cmF0dXNfazEyMyJ9....
```

eng-identity: our JWKS cache for stratusmall currently has kids: ["stratus_old_k1","stratus_old_k2"]. New kid is "stratus_k123" which isn't in cache. Looks like customer rotated and IdP already publishing new key, but our JWKS fetch hasn't picked it up due to cache TTL + a fetch error.

infra-ops-miguel: I can force a refresh of the JWKS for tenant via admin-tool. Doing now: `admin-tool jwks refresh --tenant stratusmall`

incident-bot: action logged: jwks_refresh_requested by infra-ops-miguel at 02:27:43 UTC

infra-ops-miguel: refresh returned 200 but our fetcher failed to validate the KeySet because of a malformed x5c entry on the new key (base64 decode error). This caused the fetcher to reject the whole JWKS and keep the old cache.

eng-identity: hmm. So two problems: IdP published a JWKS with malformed x5c -> reject, and customer rotated cert used by their mTLS client cert (cert chain) earlier leading to handshake failures between our dedicated nodes and their auth proxy. Need parallel mitigations.

oncall-jess: plan: 1) temporary allow soft-failback to previously-cached JWKS for stratusmall so tokens signed with new kid can be introspected using remote introspection endpoint as fallback 2) open ticket with customer to fix x5c encoding 3) restart handshake on worker-3 after updating their client cert chain. Who will take each?

eng-identity: taking #1. I'll flip the introspection fallback flag for stratusmall to ON for 15m while we validate. Command: `platform-config set tenants.stratusmall.auth.jwks_fallback=true --ttl 15m` Applying now.

platform-sre: I see the flag change propagated. Enabling fallback caused immediate drop in rejects to ~18%. Some tokens still failing because mTLS handshake from our pool to their proxy is dying. Logs: "alert handshake failure" + "certificate verify failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority" for connections to stratus-idp.svc.internal:8443

customer-stratus-eng: we accidentally rotated the client cert on the proxy but didn't include the intermediate CA cert in the bundle. We'll fix that ASAP. Rolling out corrected chain now — ETA ~10m.

infra-ops-miguel: to avoid flapping, I'll cordon worker-3 and move traffic away from it: `kubectl cordon worker-3 && kubectl drain worker-3 --ignore-daemonsets --force` then restart cert hot-reload on pool side. Doing that.

incident-bot: deployment-action: drain started by infra-ops-miguel at 02:35:01 UTC

platform-sre: after draining worker-3, mTLS handshake failures dropped by 90%. Auth success rate climbed to 96%. Still seeing some 401s for older tokens (token signed with new kid but introspection failing intermittently).

eng-identity: I've requested a second JWKS fetch and forced validation to tolerate a single x5c anomaly for a short window (we will not accept unsigned keys, just ignore malformed x5c and accept key if modulus/exponent parse OK). Doing this as an emergency rollback in staging then prod.

oncall-jess: make sure we record this deviation for postmortem, schedule rollback action after 30m if customer hasn't fixed their JWKS format.

customer-stratus-eng: intermediate cert update rolled out at 02:44 UTC. Confirming our proxy now presents full chain on port 8443.

infra-ops-miguel: re-checking TLS logs — connections to 8443 are now completing TLS handshake with full chain, JWT introspection requests succeed. Auth success stable at 99.8%.

support-ryan: customer impact summary to StratusMall: 32 minutes of elevated auth failures; mitigation applied (JWKS fallback + worker drain); root cause: customer published JWKS with malformed x5c and rotated mTLS client cert without intermediate CA — both needed to be corrected.

eng-identity: capturing action items: (A) revert temporary x5c-tolerance change in platform-config at 03:10 UTC unless customer confirms JWKS fixed, (B) add stricter JWKS validation preflight to our onboarding docs for customer IdPs, (C) add metric & alert for JWKS parse errors.

oncall-jess: handing off to eng-identity for postmortem + long-term fixes. Miguel will stay on standby for any pool-level fallout. I'm closing pager for now but keep this thread updated. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: incident resolved: SEV1 -> mitigated at 02:49:25 UTC. Duration: 37m25s. Incident ID: INC-20260314-0192

eng-identity: I'll post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems in the next hour. Thank you everyone for the fast coordination.

customer-stratus-eng: thank you, appreciate the rapid response. We'll include JWKS verification in our next deploy pipeline.
